Name: DEPTH_LINE_ST
Description: Depth line (scan line) effect: a line that sweeps out from a start to an end distance, with its speed, number of sweeps, colour, texture and fade-out.

Fields.Name: Update Step Distance
Fields.Description: Distance the line moves each frame, in metres.

Fields.Name: Number of Scans
Fields.Description: Number of times the sweep is played.

Fields.Name: Draw Type
Fields.Description: How the line is drawn, for example spreading out in a circle.

Fields.Name: Color: R
Fields.Description: Red component of the line colour (0-255).

Fields.Name: Color: G
Fields.Description: Green component of the line colour (0-255).

Fields.Name: Color: B
Fields.Description: Blue component of the line colour (0-255).

Fields.Name: Texture Param [0]: Texture Animation Speed
Fields.Description: Texture U offset scrolled per second.

Fields.Name: Texture Param [1]: Texture Animation Speed
Fields.Description: Texture U offset scrolled per second.
